data.name: NCBI BLAST+ blastp
data.description: Search protein database with protein query sequence(s)

inputs.name: subject
inputs.label: Protein FASTA subject file to use instead of a database

test_param.name: db_opts_selector
test_param.label: Subject database/sequences
options: FASTA file from your history (see warning note below)

inputs.name: blast_type
inputs.label: Type of BLAST
inputs.help: See help text for default parameter values for each BLAST type.
options: blastp - Traditional BLASTP to compare a protein query to a protein database
blastp-short - BLASTP optimized for queries shorter than 30 residues
blastp-fast - Use longer words for seeding, faster but less accurate

inputs.name: std_cols
inputs.label: Standard columns
options: qseqid = Query Seq-id (ID of your sequence)
sseqid = Subject Seq-id (ID of the database hit)
qstart = Start of alignment in query
qend = End of alignment in query
sstart = Start of alignment in subject (database hit)
send = End of alignment in subject (database hit)

inputs.name: ext_cols
inputs.label: Extended columns
options: sallseqid = All subject Seq-id(s), separated by a ';'
qseq = Aligned part of query sequence
sseq = Aligned part of subject sequence
salltitles = All subject title(s), separated by a '<>'

inputs.name: ids_cols
inputs.label: Other identifier columns
options: sallseqid = All subject Seq-id(s), separated by a ';'

inputs.name: misc_cols
inputs.label: Miscellaneous columns
options: frames = Query and subject frames separated by a '/'

inputs.name: tax_cols
inputs.label: Taxonomy columns
options: staxids = unique Subject Taxonomy ID(s), separated by a ';' (in numerical order)
sscinames = unique Subject Scientific Name(s), separated by a ';'
scomnames = unique Subject Common Name(s), separated by a ';'
sblastnames = unique Subject Blast Name(s), separated by a ';' (in alphabetical order)
sskingdoms = unique Subject Super Kingdom(s), separated by a ';' (in alphabetical order)

inputs.name: filter_query
inputs.label: Filter out low complexity regions (with SEG)

inputs.name: max_hits
inputs.label: Maximum hits to consider/show
inputs.help: Use zero for default limits. For HTML and plain text output this value is passed -num_descriptions and -num_alignments but for XML and tabular etc, this is used with -max_target_seqs instead. In either case, in addition to limiting the final output, this alters internal limits during the search, which can in some cases exclude matches which would otherwise become the best hit.

inputs.name: max_hsps
inputs.label: Maximum number of HSPs (alignments) to keep for any single query-subject pair
inputs.help: The HSPs shown will be the best as judged by expect value. If this option is not set, BLAST shows all HSPs meeting the expect value criteria

inputs.name: word_size
inputs.label: Word size for wordfinder algorithm
inputs.help: Leave blank for default, otherwise minimum 2

inputs.name: window_size
inputs.label: Multiple hits window size: use 0 to specify 1-hit algorithm, leave blank for default
inputs.help: Default window size varies with substitution matrix and BLAST type. Enter an integer to override the default.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.label: Minimum score to add a word to the BLAST lookup table.
inputs.help: Leave blank for default, which varies based on application.

inputs.name: comp_based_stats
inputs.label: Composition-based statistics
inputs.help: The default value varies based on application and task. Most common default is 2.
options:
2: Composition-based score adjustment as in Bioinformatics
                21:902-911, 2005, conditioned on sequence properties
3: Composition-based score adjustment as in Bioinformatics 21:902-911, 2005, unconditionally

inputs.name: parse_deflines
inputs.label: Should the query and subject defline(s) be parsed?
inputs.help: This affects the formatting of the query/subject ID strings

inputs.name: gilist
inputs.label: Restrict search of database to GI's listed in this file
inputs.help: This option is only available for database searches.

inputs.name: negative_gilist
inputs.label: Restrict search of database to everything except the GI's listed in this file
inputs.help: This option is only available for database searches.

inputs.name: seqidlist
inputs.label: Restrict search of database to list of SeqId's
inputs.help: This option is only available for database searches.

inputs.name: taxidlist
inputs.label: Restrict search of database to list of TaxId's
inputs.help: This option is only available for database searches.

inputs.name: negative_taxidlist
inputs.label: Restrict search of database to list of TaxId's
inputs.help: This option is only available for database searches.

test_param.name: adv_optional_id_files_opts_selector
test_param.label: Restrict search of database to a given set of ID's
test_param.help: This feature provides a means to exclude ID's from a BLAST database search. The expectation values in the BLAST results are based upon the sequences actually searched, and not on the underlying database. Note this cannot be used when comparing against a FASTA file.
options: No restriction, search the entire database

inputs.label: Minimum query coverage per hsp (percentage, 0 to 100)
inputs.help: See also the output column qcovhsp
